Neither matches. I've confirmed Phomopsis is the best candidate. Let me use my last reference view on Phomopsis to confirm.

- Phomopsis refs: all show split pods with brown/discolored/shriveled seeds - same pod-splitting + seed decay pattern

- Purple Seed Stain: purple-colored seeds, no match
- Fusarium: stem damage, no match
- Charcoal_Rot: field-wide yellowing, no match
- Soybean_Cyst_Nematode: root cysts, no match

The pod splitting while still green with seed decay inside is characteristic of Phomopsis pod blight.
